cursorCase4Context.interpretation: TurboFan OSR retains the case-4 block-context allocation on both empty and nonempty cursor paths, before the EOF branch. Context slots capture six scanner locals. This does not measure request savings or imply that all slots belong only to the EOF IIFE.

cursorCase4Context.explanation: No context allocation between dispatch to case4 and the EOF branch or immediately following nonempty continuation. Two remaining optimized context sites belong to state2.

inliningDifference.causalAttribution: Different inlining and larger register/frame layouts are observed confounders; no measurement isolates their timing impact.

timingScreen.method: Geometric mean across four sources of candidate/control median over three rounds, at fixed request number. Separate compiler processes per row; all five calls checked.
timingScreen.decision: Reject promotion: targeted allocation removed but cold result is null and fifth-call timing regresses.
